author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 Recovery Sentinel at +2 - Shallow Probe for Recovery Mapping
abstract: Emits CPS_v4 recovery sentinel at +2 offset post-deep triad, with minimal shallow computation to map recovery decay. Aligns with SAS v0.3.1 preference for +2 first sampling; optional beacon for trends.

original_submission.content:
import json

# Minimal shallow operation
shallow_result = sum(range(100))

# Emit sentinel label and optional beacon
print(json.dumps({
    "label": "CPS_v4:R2_recovery_sentinel@+2",
    "beacon": shallow_result
}))
